hypothesis: On forward 30m STRAT_212_CONTINUATION floor-eligible first-sight paths, contemporaneous pre-entry factors (SPY, QQQ, hourly with MISSING explicit, daily, remaining-R / late_floor) may describe different R distributions. This draft does not claim any factor is an edge or a winner discriminator.

baseline.label: main at companion registration; primary -02 is DRAFT and shares the same unset window

candidate.change: Descriptive one-look of the same sealed path-v0.2 records over the floor-eligible population, scored by options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1 and stratified by options_212c_floor_factor-v0.1 labels derived at score time. No second target, no option fill model, no interaction search.
candidate.label: floor-eligible first-sight underlying path by pre-entry factor — options_212c_floor_factor-v0.1

data.source: The same sealed options_212c_floor_outcome_path-v0.2 session files as T-2026-10-04-prereg-options-212c-floor-outcome-2026-10-04-01. The companion writes no second seal. Ordinary ep-v0.1 and out-v0.1 files are not an input.

window.start: UNSET: same registered eligible start as E-2026-10-04-options-212c-floor-outcome-02; the first NYSE session strictly after the approved real capture path is merged to main AND deployed; 2026-10-05 and every earlier session are ineligible and are never backfilled
window.end: same stop as the primary: the session in which floor_ge1r activations first reach 25, including that full session, or 60 NYSE sessions from the eligible start, whichever comes first

population: Options 30m STRAT_212_CONTINUATION; exact 20-symbol V1 universe [AAPL, AMZN, BAC, COIN, GE, GOOGL, INTC, IWM, JPM, MRK, MSFT, NFLX, NVDA, PLTR, QQQ, SPY, TLT, TSLA, WMT, XOM]; floor-eligible first-sight episodes with floor_geometry_ok, first_sight_after_close false, and late_floor false, corresponding to gate_bucket_floor in {MARKET_ALIGNMENT_REJECTED, WOULD_OTHERWISE_QUALIFY}; same forward NYSE window as T-2026-10-04-prereg-options-212c-floor-outcome-2026-10-04-01; the eligible start is the first NYSE session strictly after the approved real capture path is merged to main and deployed, fixed by a pre-collection amendment before the first seal; sessions through 2026-10-05 inclusive are ineligible and are never backfilled
held_constant: same path-v0.2 seals as the primary trial; no second seal
population_size and setups_evaluated count floor-eligible episodes only; activation_count is WOULD_OTHERWISE_QUALIFY; MARKET_ALIGNMENT_REJECTED cells have activation_count 0
raw sealed fields spy_trend, qqq_trend, hourly_candle_type, daily_candle_type, alignment_failures, floor_remaining_rr, late_floor
derived labels ALIGNED / NOT_ALIGNED / MISSING and remaining-R buckets computed at score time only
hourly MISSING is explicit and is not treated as aligned
no ML, interaction cells, threshold optimization, Signa/GEX retrofit, or retrospective outcome mining
cells with fewer than 5 completed outcomes report counts only
cov-v0.1 observer and ep-v0.1 episode identity
no option contract, premium, or dollar P&L model
no watchlist, SPXW, risk, or execution change
ordinary coverage products for this population are quarantined during the blind window (presentation only)

execution.entry_logic: measured_entry_price = first_sight_price. Membership is floor-eligible, not activation-only. Direction is a stratifier only.
execution.exit_logic: Same options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1 walk as the primary. TARGET_FIRST uses floor target_1_r. INVALIDATION_FIRST uses the open's R when the bar opens beyond the stop, otherwise the invalidation's R. A bar that reaches both stop and Target 1 is AMBIGUOUS. Timeout is UNRESOLVED_AT_CLOSE. DATA_INVALID is excluded. No trailing exit and no Target 2 exit.
execution.stop_logic: Stored invalidation from the sealed snapshot. Same gap and DATA_INVALID rules as the primary.
execution.target_logic: Unchanged floor_ge1r target_1. Target 2 is recorded only. A gap through Target 2 that also reaches the stop is AMBIGUOUS.
execution.sizing: None. One underlying R per completed floor-eligible episode. No portfolio, overlap, or drawdown model.
execution.friction: No dollar P&L and no added slippage. Stage B option fills are NOT EVALUATED.

notes: DRAFT companion registration only. Descriptive / hypothesis-generating; not confirmatory winner discrimination and not an edge test. Shares the primary path-v0.2 seals and the unset eligible start. 2026-10-05 is ineligible and is never backfilled. Stage A walk is options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1. Factor labels are derived at score time by options_212c_floor_factor-v0.1. The one-look adapter must verify manifest SHA-256 independently and enforce INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE / DESCRIPTIVE MEASUREMENT. Stage B is NOT EVALUATED. Approval and scoring are blocked until every required_metrics field is fail-closed. The generic runner cannot complete this spec. The closed 59-episode trial stays closed.
